/* CSS placed here will be applied to all skins */
#article, #bodyContent, #mw_content { text-align: justify; }

body.page-Ralju_papri h1.firstHeading, body.page-ralju_papri h1.firstHeading {display:none;}
body.page-ralju_papri .wikEdLogo{display:none;}
body #ca-view{display:none;}
body #ca-purge{display:none;}

#footer { display:none; }
div#mw-panel {width:11em;}
div#mw-panel {text-align:right; margin-left:1px;padding-left:0;padding-top:0px; top:100px;}
div#p-logo {top: -100px;height:100px;}
div#p-logo a {height:100px;}
.p-navigation {margin-top: -100px;}

div#mw-panel div.portal {margin:0;}
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.body ul li {line-height: 1.7em; }
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.body .thumb .thumbcaption {margin:0;font-size:70%;}
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.tright {padding:0;margin:0;}
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.magnify, div#portlet div.magnify {display:none;}
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.body {margin:0;}
